application_review: Two continuous lifts with locally equal cosets modulo the original discrete subgroup differ locally by a fixed right lattice element. This is proved from the discrete subspace neighborhood filter, without normality. A continuous lift of a smooth map through those cosets is therefore smooth.

For a Lie group with a proved global smooth Euclidean parametrization, the actual discrete-subgroup coset topology receives covering charts. Their overlaps are proved smooth using the local constant lattice discrepancy, giving a genuine infinite-smooth manifold structure. Neither compactness nor a smooth quotient atlas is assumed.

The original quotient projection is proved smooth, and smooth maps descend whenever their compositions with the original projection are smooth. The proof uses the constructed local sections and their exact quotient right-inverse identities.

The proved original native exponential diffeomorphism instantiates this construction on the actual original nilpotent-group coset space, for any discrete subgroup. The original quotient projection is smooth.

The existing actual array exponential diffeomorphism and the proved discreteness of its exact all-integer lattice instantiate the same smooth quotient construction. Every original integer-input coset evaluation is smooth, by descent of the literal group evaluation to the original native coset manifold.

Original integer-input translations on the actual array coset space are smooth, have smooth opposite-shift inverses, and are assembled into diffeomorphisms proved to apply exactly the retained coset translations. No quotient-group structure or normality assumption is introduced.

Reviewed nonnormal quotient orientation: equality of left cosets is f(x)^(-1)*g(x) in Gamma, so the local discrepancy yields right multiplication by the fixed lattice element. No quotient group is used.

Reviewed charts and smoothness for circularity: covering maps and local sections use only the actual discrete subgroup and original topology. Smooth overlaps follow from smooth original right multiplication and the proved global group parametrization. Quotient manifold and projection smoothness are then proved, before using smooth descent.

Reviewed native specialization: both global parametrizations are existing proved original exponential diffeomorphisms. The original Gamma and actual all-integer pointwise array lattice are retained literally; their previously proved discrete topologies are used. No arbitrary replacement lattice or hypothetical smooth quotient is supplied.

Reviewed evaluation and shift descent: their representative formulas are definitionally the retained integer evaluation and translation. The resulting quotient diffeomorphism is explicitly proved equal to the original quotient translation.

All new named declarations receive strict Lean elaboration and transitive axiom checks. Existing proof-source hashes and prior declaration axiom sets remain fixed. No independent kernel replay or full StrongConjecture proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Array input translations are now proved smooth with smooth inverses in the existing original exponential charts. Original affine power-times-basepoint model arrays are proved to belong to the actual native array group; their exact evaluations, input translations and linear time orbit are proved both in the group and in its exact lattice coset space. Actual original and array discrete-lattice quotient manifolds are now constructed on the retained coset topologies; original quotient projections, all integer-input quotient evaluations and original quotient translations are smooth, with the latter having proved smooth inverses. Finite-product joint-state assembly, quantitative smooth-observable estimates and downstream model-orbit integration remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the finite-product native polynomial-array joint model action and its connection to all prescribed readings, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
